title: Black and White Patterned Kitchen Backsplash
summary: Completed kitchen backsplash with a high-contrast black and white patterned tile installed around countertops, sink, cooktop and appliance areas.
problem: The kitchen needed a distinctive backsplash that would create contrast with the existing wood cabinets and light countertops.
solution: Installed the patterned tile across multiple connected wall sections, maintaining alignment around outlets, corners, the cooktop and raised counter area.
materials: Black and white patterned mosaic tile
